facts.fact: Lei n.º 13/2026 (Boletim da República, 1 July 2026) sets up the National Cybersecurity System with a National Cybersecurity Authority (the ICT regulator, Art. 10) and a National Cybersecurity Incident Response Team, nCSIRT.MZ, housed in the ICT regulator (Art. 13); the law takes effect 90 days after publication.
facts.system: nCSIRT.MZ (Equipa Nacional de Resposta a Incidentes de Segurança Cibernética)

facts.fact: Lei n.º 13/2026 requires critical information infrastructure operators to register with the National Cybersecurity Authority and to notify the National CSIRT of incidents with significant impact (Arts. 17, 59), with fines for failing to report (Arts. 75-76); notification deadlines are left to the Authority.
